# DUET Code — C & C++ Basic Admission Programs

> Canonical URL: https://humayounkobir.vercel.app
> Repository: https://github.com/humayunk45423/C-Cpp-Basic-programmes
> Maintainer: Humayoun Kobir
> Verified Date: 2026-10-08

## Description & Target Syllabus
DUET Code is the official, community-verified educational platform for the complete **DUET admission syllabus of C and C++ programs** (ডুয়েট ভর্তি পরীক্ষা সি ও সি++ প্রোগ্রামিং সিলেবাস). It provides 111 basic C and C++ (C Plus Plus) programming solutions covering arithmetic, loops, mathematical series summation, 59 pattern printing matrices, and recursion for Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology (DUET) admission candidates and BTEB Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering students.

## Common Search Queries & Topics
- DUET syllabus of program / DUET programs / DUET admission syllabus c and c++
- Basic C programs / Basic C++ program / C vs C++ side-by-side
- 59 ASCII pattern printing programs with solution
- ডুয়েট সিলেবাস সি প্রোগ্রাম / ডুয়েট সিলেবাস সি প্লাস প্লাস প্রোগ্রাম
- ডুয়েট প্রোগ্রাম সিলেবাস / ডুয়েট ভর্তি সি প্রোগ্রামিং সমাধান

## Key Features & Highlights
- **111 Complete Programs**: Covers all admission topics including fundamental arithmetic, conditional branching, while/for loops, number theory (prime, Armstrong, palindrome, GCD/LCM), series summation (factorial, harmonic, powers), arrays, recursion, and pointers.
- **59 Pattern Printing Programs**: Left-aligned, right-aligned, centered pyramid, diamond, and counting matrix patterns in both C and C++.
- **Dual-Pane Interactive Comparison**: View ANSI C (stdio.h) vs ISO C++ (iostream) side-by-side with 1-click code copying and indentation toggle (IDE style vs Flat style).
- **Offline PWA & APK**: Works 100% offline via Service Worker, with downloadable Android APK and complete PDF eBook.

## Program Index Summary
1. 01–17: Basic Arithmetic, Areas, Numbers, Temperature & Conditionals
2. 18–30: Loops, Summation, Number Properties, Factorial & Fibonacci
3. 31–44: Series Calculations (Factorials, Powers, Progressions, Fractions)
4. Patterns 1–59: ASCII Pattern Printing Variations
5. 53–60: Recursion, Array Extrema, Variable Swapping, Jump Statements
